notes: Government of Alberta provincial scholarship administered through Alberta Student Aid and funded by the Alberta Heritage Scholarship Fund. Verified live on the official page: 'Schools will select recipients based on the minimum eligibility criteria for the Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship, and any additional eligibility criteria set by the school.' No institution or supervising professor is attached to the award; recipients are selected by their own host Alberta post-secondary institution's student awards office. Government scheme with no attached institution, so no supervisor research was performed.

Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE) is a Quebec provincial research scholarship managed by the Fonds de recherche du Quebec - secteur Nature et technologies and commissioned/funded by the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec. Verified live on the official programme rules page: candidates 'must be preselected by a Quebec university or the CCTT network as of October 23, 2025' and 'The universities and the CCTT network and the CSC assume full responsibility for candidate preselection.' A supervisor's letter of acceptance is required from the candidate's own chosen host, but no supervising professor is named on or tied to the scheme itself. Government scheme with no attached institution, so no supervisor research was performed.

Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA) is a federal research training award run by SSHRC. Verified live on the official page: value '$70,000 per year for 2 years', deadline 'September 10, 2026 (8:00 p.m. eastern)'. The programme requires a proposed supervisor who completes a Research Appraisal form, but the supervisor is chosen by the applicant and is not named on or attached to the award. Federal scheme with no attached institution, so no supervisor research was performed.

Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development - Phase 2 (SEED-2) / Canada-ASEAN SEED is a short-term government exchange scholarship offered by Global Affairs Canada. Verified live on the official page: 'SEED scholarships are facilitated through institutional collaborations and student exchange agreements between post-secondary institutions in Canada and their partner institutions in ASEAN countries' and 'Canadian institutions must apply on behalf of eligible candidates.' A 'Letter of invitation from the Canadian supervisor (graduate students only)' is a required supporting document, but no supervising professor is named on or tied to the programme. Government scheme with no attached institution, so no supervisor research was performed.

Schulich Leader Scholarships are an undergraduate STEM entrance scholarship funded by the Schulich Foundation and co-administered by UJA Federation of Greater Toronto. Verified live on schulichleaders.com: 'One hundred are awarded to entrepreneurial-minded high school graduates enrolling in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Math program at 20 partner universities across Canada' and 'Every high school in Canada can nominate one graduating student each year.' This is a private foundation entrance award with no research supervision component and no single attached institution or faculty. No supervising professor is tied to the scholarship, so no supervisor research was performed.
